svg.title: AWS · Keep the application private; recover within a region
svg.desc: Two zones contain private application and database subnets. A regional ALB reaches either app pool. Both pools use the RDS writer endpoint. The synchronous standby can be promoted but cannot serve application reads.
svg.text: AWS · Keep the application private; recover within a region
DEPLOYMENT VIEW / HTTPS → application pool → one database writer
VPC · public ingress and private application/data subnets
ALB health checks remove failed targets. RDS promotes the standby. Applications
reconnect through the DB endpoint and retry safely; retain capacity in AZ B.
EC2 gives runtime control, but you own images and patching. The extra zone
costs capacity. This handles a zone outage; backups and regional recovery
Solid arrows: labelled traffic or replication. Dashed arrows: policy/control. Conceptual design; assumptions and sources in the chapter.
